title: Object folders root (map/objects/objects.json)
description: Which packed object data files there are, with their versions (docs/object-folders-spec.md, section 1), read and written by crates/w3proj/src/object_layout.rs. A kind or half that is missing means pack writes no such file; one that is listed is written even without objects. Unknown keys are ignored.

format.description: w3proj.objectfolders/1; a later 1.x reads the same, a newer major version is refused

files.description: per kind (folder name): the version of war3map.<ext> (data) and war3mapSkin.<ext> (skin); a campaign's are war3campaign.<ext> and war3campaignSkin.<ext>
